evals.name: taffy-plain-html
evals.prompt: Here's the landing page for my studio site (landing.html). Add the taffy gooey edge between the sections. Save the finished page and anything it needs into the outputs folder.
evals.expected_output: landing.html with the engine loaded, the work, about and footer sections marked, and Taffy behaving exactly like the lab's tab 3.
expectations: The page runs in Chrome with no console errors
The work, about and footer top edges all goo when scrolled past
Peak goo height after a standard flick is within 2px of the lab's Taffy
On release the edge dips below the line in the upper colour, within 2px of the lab's Taffy dip
Goo height tracks the lab's Taffy frame by frame (mean difference under 2px over 130 frames)
The goo engine is the lab engine, byte for byte

evals.name: honey-webflow
evals.prompt: Building a client's stats section in Webflow. section_stats is dark green #0E3B2E and sits directly under section_intro, which is cream #F4F1EA. I want the honey goo on the top edge of section_stats. Write me exactly what to paste and where, saved as instructions.md in the outputs folder.
evals.expected_output: Step-by-step Webflow instructions: custom attribute on section_stats, the engine pasted inline in footer custom code with a honey init, colour handling, and a note that it only shows on the published site.
expectations: Says where each piece goes in Webflow: an attribute or setting on section_stats, and code in Site or Page custom code before </body>
The pasted code is the lab engine verbatim, started with the honey variant
Covers both colours: #0E3B2E for the goo and #F4F1EA above it
Warns that it won't show on the Designer canvas or Preview, only on the published or staging site
Every code block is safe to paste: script tags balanced and under Webflow's 50,000-character limit
Only the top edge of section_stats is affected

evals.name: slosh-nextjs
evals.prompt: Our Next.js homepage (Home.jsx, app router, Tailwind with bg-ink #121613 and bg-paper #FAFFFA) has three stacked sections. Add the slosh gooey edge between them. Save the updated component and any new files into the outputs folder.
evals.expected_output: Home.jsx marked up with a client-side effect that initialises the engine with slosh and destroys it on unmount; the engine file copied unchanged; the hero left unmarked.
expectations: The goo engine is the lab engine, byte for byte
Starts in a client-side effect with the slosh variant and cleans up on unmount
The thesis and portfolio sections are marked and the hero is not
No new npm dependencies are needed
Nothing touches window at module top level, so server rendering is safe
